title: Alignment stage idles about 7% of thread time
body: On the mgy run the alignment branch reports 93.0% busy over 175.7 s with 48 threads, so about 12 s of thread idle, more than any serial item but the db write. The likely cause is tail imbalance: search.rs runs par_chunks(100) over seeds grouped by query, so the last chunks leave threads waiting. Smaller chunks or interleaving queries would recover part of it. Measure by chunk size before changing anything.
